description: Fetch Level 2 corporate hierarchy for an LEI: direct parent, ultimate parent, and direct children. Use to map ownership trees across multinational groups. Accepts a company NAME as well as an LEI.

lei.description: 20-character LEI code (e.g. "HWUPKR0MPOU8FGXBT394") OR the company NAME (e.g. "Apple Inc") — a name is resolved here automatically and the match is echoed back as resolved_from_name. Do not guess an LEI: a wrong-but-well-formed code used to return an empty hierarchy, which reads as "this company has no parent or subsidiaries" rather than as an error.

name: get_lei_relationships
